headline: 885 dead as measles outbreak claims 5 more lives in 24 hours
summary: The death toll from the ongoing measles outbreak has risen to 885, with five more children dying within a single day.
details: The death toll from a measles outbreak has reached 885, with five more children dying in the last 24 hours.
The victims include both children with confirmed measles and those showing symptoms of the disease.
Health authorities are monitoring the situation as the number of fatalities continues to rise.
The outbreak has put significant pressure on pediatric wards and healthcare facilities across the country.

headline_marked: Savar: [[Pressure cooker bomb defused]] by police after blast shakes area
headline: Savar: Pressure cooker bomb defused by police after blast shakes area
summary: A suspected bomb wrapped in black tape inside a pressure cooker was discovered in a mosque field in Savar, prompting a massive police response.
details: Police have defused a pressure cooker bomb in the Sadhapur area of Savar. The DMP Bomb Disposal Unit arrived at the scene around 1:45 PM and successfully neutralized the device at 3:28 PM.
The operation resulted in a loud blast and a plume of white smoke, which was heard and seen by local residents who had been evacuated from the area.
The device was first discovered by locals on Tuesday night around 1:30 AM. They found a blue plastic drum containing a pressure cooker wrapped in black scotch tape.
Local residents removed the pressure cooker from the drum and placed it on the mosque field, before alerting the police.
According to police, three unidentified persons were seen leaving the blue plastic drum in the mosque field during the night.
The police cordoned off the area and waited for the DMP Bomb Disposal Unit to ensure the safety of the people in the area.
caption:
A pressure cooker bomb was found in a mosque field in Savar, sparking a panic.

Police have defused a pressure cooker bomb in the Sadhapur area of Savar. The DMP Bomb Disposal Unit arrived at the scene around 1:45 PM and successfully neutralized the device at 3:28 PM.

The operation resulted in a loud blast and a plume of white smoke, which was heard and seen by local residents who had been evacuated from the area.

The device was first discovered by locals on Tuesday night around 1:30 AM. They found a blue plastic drum containing a pressure cooker wrapped in black scotch tape.

Local residents removed the pressure cooker from the drum and placed it on the mosque field, before alerting the police.

According to police, three unidentified persons were seen leaving the blue plastic drum in the mosque field during the night.

The police cordoned off the area and waited for the DMP Bomb Disposal Unit to ensure the safety of the people in the area.

#Savar #BombScare #Bangladesh #Security #BreakingNews

Source: Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star, Somoy News
